data.exact_reserve_text: Claims incurred, net of reinsurance, include adverse prior year development of GBP 12.3m (2021: favourable development of GBP 5.1m). Prior year claims development is analysed by line of business in the table below.

named_events.loss_description: The catastrophe loss ratio for the year has improved, despite exposure to Hurricane Ian.
The syndicate has limited exposure to the conflict in Ukraine, with ultimate losses currently estimated to be GBP 1.5m.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2022 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 116.515m. During 2022 the syndicate recorded a prior-year strengthening of approximately GBP 12.39m (10.6% of opening reserves), driven principally by adverse development in its reinsurance book with a small favourable movement in property. The managing agent notes inflationary pressures have impacted reserving. The movement is reported in the prior year development table and is reflected across the older underwriting years (2018-2020).

data.data_quality_notes: Primary prior-year movement taken from the Prior Year Reserve Development table (Note 4) which shows an (adverse) movement of GBP 12,390k. There is some ambiguity because the narrative phrasing earlier references a net prior-year movement within the 'Claims incurred, net of reinsurance' discussion; a net claims development triangle is also present and suggests a net release when read at net level. Preference was given to the LOB movement table which provides gross figures. The claims development triangle is provided (net) and was cross-checked; users should note this possible gross/net presentation ambiguity.
